title: Okubuulirira Okuwandiikiddwa mu Magezi
intro: Teebereza ng’oyimiridde ku mabbali g’ekifaananyi ekimanyiddwa si lwa byamagero oba obwakabaka, wabula olw’ebigambo ebikyalungamya emitima ne leero. Omuddu wa Allah ono yafuna ekirabo eky’omuwendo era n’ayiwa okwebaza mu buli kubuulirira okwaweebwa omuyizi omuto omwagalwa.
clues: Allah yampa omukisa n’amagezi, era nalagirwa okugwebaza.
Nnayogera ne mutabani wange n’okubuulirira okw’ekisa, nga mmulabula n’okwagala n’okufaayo.
Nagamba mutabani wange nti okukwatagana ne Allah kikyamu kya maanyi nnyo.
Nawa omwana wange amagezi okussaawo okusaba, okulagira ekituufu, okugaana ekikyamu, n’okugumiikiriza.
Nalabula omwana wange obutakyusa ttama olw’amalala wadde okutambulira ku nsi mu maanyi.
Nayigiriza omwana wange okubeera ow’ekigero mu sipiidi n’okukendeeza ku ddoboozi, kubanga amaloboozi agasinga obukambwe ge kuwuuma kw’endogoyi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
